source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: Newton's 1st law: inertia. 2nd: F = m×a. 3rd: every action has an equal, opposite reaction.
bullets.ne: न्युटनको पहिलो नियम: जडत्व। दोस्रो: F = m×a। तेस्रो: हरेक क्रियाको बराबर विपरीत प्रतिक्रिया।

bullets.en: Speed of sound ≈ 340 m/s; speed of light = 3×10⁸ m/s.
bullets.ne: ध्वनिको गति ≈ 340 m/s; प्रकाशको गति = 3×10⁸ m/s।

bullets.en: Kinetic energy = ½mv²; potential energy = mgh; work = force × distance; power = work ÷ time.
bullets.ne: गतिज ऊर्जा = ½mv²; स्थितिज ऊर्जा = mgh; कार्य = बल × दूरी; शक्ति = कार्य ÷ समय।

bullets.en: Ohm's law: V = I×R. Electric power: P = V×I. Household energy unit: kWh.
bullets.ne: ओहमको नियम: V = I×R। विद्युत् शक्ति: P = V×I। घरायसी ऊर्जा एकाइ: kWh।

bullets.en: Concave lens = diverging; convex lens = converging.
bullets.ne: अवतल लेन्स = अपसारी; उत्तल लेन्स = अभिसारी।

bullets.en: pH = −log[H⁺]. pH 7 = neutral; below 7 acidic; above 7 basic.
bullets.ne: pH = −log[H⁺]। pH 7 = उदासीन; 7 भन्दा कम अम्लीय; बढी क्षारीय।

bullets.en: A hygrometer measures humidity (relative humidity of air).
Citric acid is the natural acid in citrus fruits (lemon, orange).
bullets.ne: सिट्रिक एसिड कागती/सुन्तला जस्ता अमिलो फलमा हुने प्राकृतिक अम्ल हो।

bullets.en: Zoology = study of animals; botany = study of plants.
bullets.ne: जन्तुविज्ञान = जीवजन्तुको अध्ययन; वनस्पतिविज्ञान = वनस्पतिको अध्ययन।

bullets.en: SI base units: metre, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, mole, candela.
bullets.ne: SI आधारभूत एकाइ: मिटर, किलोग्राम, सेकेन्ड, एम्पियर, केल्भिन, मोल, क्यान्डेला।
